query: Weather stations and hydrological gauges will monitor climate and hazard conditions.
Forecasting systems will produce weather, flood and drought predictions.
A maintained platform will integrate climate, hazard and exposure data.
Health surveillance will incorporate weather data to predict climate-sensitive disease.
A weather information portal will publish forecasts and seasonal bulletins for users.
Climate and hazard information systems will be established and maintained.
A mobile agricultural advisory service will tell farmers when to plant and irrigate using weather forecasts.
A digital irrigation scheduling tool will advise water managers how much water to release during drought.
A digital planning tool will use flood-risk data to rank investments and schedule protective maintenance.
A digital tool will combine climate-shock data with social registries to target support.
A mobile application will advise households and businesses how to adapt to climate risks.
A mobile advisory tool will use weather forecasts to recommend protective actions to farmers and businesses.
